svg.title: NeNe Ledger application icon
svg.desc: NeNe Ledger application icon: a table with a header band, a column rule, a row rule and one selected amber cell, on a cream rounded tile with a charcoal outline. Colors are the NeNe Clock palette (charcoal #1A1917, cream #F5F2EB, amber #D08C3F). Corners outside rx=24 are fully transparent.
